professionalSummary.text: Gathered requirements from field technicians and depot staff through ride-alongs and depot visits, translating them into user stories with testable acceptance criteria for the technician app's offline checklist and parts-scan features.

professionalSummary.text: Organized acceptance rounds for four app releases with technicians at the training site, maintaining results per criterion in a shared sheet.
professionalSummary.witness: Organised acceptance rounds for four app releases at the training site with a rotating group of technicians, and kept the results per criterion in a shared sheet.

professionalSummary.text: Coordinated release scope with engineering and field-service management, documenting decision ownership: engineering lead set scope and dates, field-service manager approved regional rollout order.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated release scope with the engineering lead and the field-service manager in the release planning meeting; the engineering lead decided scope and dates, and the field-service manager approved the rollout order across regions.

professionalSummary.text: Documented release limitations and trainer hand-over steps for each app release, including specific notes on parts-scan compatibility with newer handheld models and required trainer actions.
professionalSummary.witness: Wrote up each app release for the regional trainers, flagging that parts-scan only worked on the newer handheld model and listing the steps trainers had to take over.

experienceHighlights.text: Spent two years as the dedicated Product Requirements Analyst for the technician app, managing the full lifecycle from requirement gathering through acceptance testing and release documentation.
experienceHighlights.witness: Spent about two years on the service-platform team as the analyst for the technician app: intake, stories, acceptance rounds and release write-ups.
